verdict.comment: This can go to WITHOUT DELAY, a C&D winner who was a good second at Musselburgh last week. Ideal Guest may be the chief danger.

comments.goingunderground: Not beaten far when fifth at Wetherby in April but has struggled on his three starts since
comments.goldenprosperity: Running well last month (6f/5.5f) and denied clear run last time; stamina to prove at 7f
comments.idealguest: Some good form in defeat over 6f for this yard; he can be involved if still okay at 7f
comments.johnkirkup: 10yo who has produced the odd fair performance this year but is winless since October 2023
comments.langholm: Hard to win with nowadays but arrives in good form and has a solid record here
comments.obeejo: Four-time course winner who is on a dangerous mark but hasn't threatened this year
comments.pinjarra: 0-12 but fair efforts on last two starts and holds each-way possibilities
comments.queensroadrevue: Below last winning mark but has to raise game after two below-par runs
comments.raincap: 8yo whose losing run goes back to July 2023 but he's in good heart and likes it here
comments.withoutdelay: Went close at Musselburgh last week; likes it there but has also won over this C&D
comments.yoshimi: Three AW wins between last October and this January but well beaten the last twice

races.raceComment: withoutdelay is marginally preferred with a score of 55.8%, holding clear edges in more progressive over langholm. Placed in 1 of last 6 starts, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: This could be the day when COSMIC SOUL gets his head in front where it matters. He may have most to fear from Wannabeawallaby.

comments.cosmicsoul: Now 0-17 under rules but runner-up in his last three races; has to go well.
comments.ladyphoebe: Creditable fourth here on reappearance and respectable fifth at Hamilton last month.
comments.myboymax: Three places behind Cosmic Soul when fifth of eight over C&D last month.
comments.propagation: Longstanding maiden who has been tried over a variety of distances; steps up in trip here.
comments.starofjupiter: Proved his stamina when runner-up to a stablemate at Chepstow last Wednesday.
comments.teamendeavour: Has shown little this year since returning from a lengthy lay-off.
comments.wannabeawallaby: 0-17 but has made the frame on each of his last four starts since returning to turf.

races.raceComment: myboymax is confidently preferred with a score of 54.4%, holding clear edges in better ratings and better suited by conditions and stronger recent form and superior course form over wannabeawallaby. Placed in 2 of last 6 starts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: Unexposed pair Tommy's Promise and HINITSA BAY look interesting and a narrow vote goes to the latter under Billy Loughnane.

comments.anglosaxson: Four of his five wins here but last two C&D starts were not good; questions to answer
comments.embarked: Second over C&D (good) up with this year's best efforts; not matched that since, though
comments.fireeyes: Running well in this headgear combination; off the mark on turf latest; can go well again
comments.galileoscompass: First go at 1m when causing a 40-1 shock last time; 5lb penalty and needs to back that up
comments.heerssadie: Won her last two, both here; still has stamina to prove but escapes a penalty for latest
comments.hinitsabay: Close second on C&D handicap debut; poor next time but bounced back latest; unexposed
comments.matchanthem: Probably not quite so good on turf but he's down to his last winning mark; not ruled out
comments.nonews: Regressive for the past 18 months and he's passed over again
comments.primrosemaid: Placed twice over C&D then flopped over further last time; not ruled out back at this trip
comments.royaljet: Hasn't matched sole win for initial yard & this headgear combination didn't help last time
comments.specialistview: Modest form since returning this year after wind surgery; latest third needs building on
comments.tommyspromise: Found his feet for this yard, third both starts and went fairly close last time; player

races.raceComment: matchanthem is marginally preferred with a score of 51.4%, holding clear edges in more progressive and more reliable profile over heerssadie. Placed in 2 of last 6 starts. Strong pace likely with multiple front-runners. Key attributes include improving, though unfavorable draw need consideration.

verdict.comment: Given normal improvement from his seasonal debut at Navan, GRANITE BAY has good prospects of adding to last year's three wins.

comments.balticbird: Versatile sort, chase winner in May, second in the 2m amateur handicap at Galway last year
comments.brosnatown: Course maiden winner at 1m4f, also a winner at Dundalk, chance if forgiven most recent run
comments.daytrader: Plenty of Flat racing experience in France, every chance now after hurdles win at Listowel
comments.granitebay: Progressive last year, made a bright start to the new season over this trip at Navan
comments.londonofficecallin: Ended last season's Flat campaign with back-to-back wins, two hurdle wins since, respected
comments.notjustanyeagle: Won his fifth race when landing a 1m4f handicap at Leopardstown in May, below best latest
comments.rockofireland: Made the frame on his first two starts this season, progress has not been sustained

races.raceComment: londonofficecallin is marginally preferred with a score of 50.5%, holding clear edges in more proven at trip and better suited by conditions and stronger recent form over balticbird. Won 3 of last 6 starts. Ground (Good) looks ideal with 5 wins from 21 starts in similar conditions. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter. Key attributes include optimal distance and positive comments, though step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: Bidding for a four-timer at this track is I Bid You Ajou but FACETHEPUCKOUT may be capable of bringing the winning run to an end

comments.bluesemperor: Best run this year came last time at the Curragh; a repeat of that would make him a player
comments.exquisiteacclaim: Finished a neck ahead of Blues Emperor last time; below his best this term but good chance
comments.facethepuckout: Narrow winner last time; won off 1lb higher mark last year; can go well again
comments.fourblondes: Sole win was a maiden on this card last year; can't be ruled out
comments.ibidyouajou: Winner of last three starts over 6f at this track; upped to 7f now in small field; chance
comments.imperialdream: Winner of Curragh handicap off 74 last year; moderate on April return; improvement needed

races.raceComment: exquisiteacclaim is marginally preferred with a score of 49.6%, holding clear edges in better ratings over ibidyouajou. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Going is a significant concern - yet to win on Good ground from 21 attempts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter. Key attributes include optimal distance, though step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

comments.bellamistiko: Makes seasonal return for new stable with tongue tie applied but has a lot to find.
comments.clonmacash: Three-time AW winner is 0-14 on turf; okay runs at Leopardstown recently; chance
comments.darkdeserthighway: Three-time AW winner; sole turf win came four years ago; best watched on return
comments.dynamicforce: No show when favourite last time; two seconds prior to that; has the ability to feature
comments.expertanalysis: Poor runs as a 2yo; tailed off on return eight days ago; hard to see him featuring
comments.imspartacus: 0-16 on turf; ran on well to finish eighth of 16 last time over 7f; worth another try
comments.maskedangel: Well beaten at this track over 6f on handicap debut; not obviously well treated
comments.nevernotlucky: Well beaten in two runs since a good fourth of 12 last year; more needed on handicap debut
comments.nokneenever: Ran well in defeat in soft condition maidens last year; RR and PU in two maiden hurdles
comments.ohmali: Third over 1m on heavy ground in April; faded over 1m last time; drops back in trip here
comments.pinballwizard: Good second over this trip in May; drops back to 7f following two poor runs; interesting
comments.portlouis: Winner in May off 70; run last time was encouraging; can be involved with 7lb claimer
comments.sennasgirl: Second in seasonal return but below that form in two subsequent runs; handicap debutante
comments.unamatata: Winner of a maiden over C&D last year; hasn't offered a great deal since that win
comments.venetian: Winner on AW in March; not a clear passage when third last time; interesting runner
comments.verhoyen: 15lb lower than when winner of this race last year; poor since; needs a revival
comments.zaraahmando: Winner at Limerick last time over 7f; raised 8lb for that but one for the shortlist

races.raceComment: verhoyen is marginally preferred with a score of 44.8%, holding clear edges in better ratings and superior course form and more progressive over zaraahmando, though step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: The filly MOLTEN SEA is a stayer on the up for William Haggas and she can add to last month's win at Nottingham.

comments.capone: Pulled up early over C&D six weeks ago but went close over C&D 13 days previously
comments.comtedeloir: Won over C&D in January then continued in good form; contender if fully tuned up
comments.gallantlion: Stamina to prove but won in new blinkers two starts ago and cheekpieces may now be a plus
comments.hydroplane: Returned from 2-year absence with creditable 3rd at Chester; may be able to build on that
comments.kingdomofstars: Has gone close over C&D and at Chelmsford the last twice; a first win may well be imminent
comments.moelarthur: Went very close over C&D last time; back up in grade today but might not be far away
comments.moltensea: Progressive stayer who could continue to progress for her top yard; key player
comments.starlegend: Posted Flat hat-trick in May/June and solid efforts over hurdles the last twice; respected
comments.sundancergirl: Didn't take to hurdling on yard debut; 4-time Flat winner; not ruled out back in this code

races.raceComment: starlegend is marginally preferred with a score of 57.0%, holding clear edges in better ratings and more proven at trip and better suited by conditions and more progressive and more reliable profile over moelarthur. Won 3 of last 6 starts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter. Key attributes include optimal distance and improving, though unfavorable draw need consideration.

verdict.comment: Top of the list is the progressive I FOLLOW RIVERS (nap), who has form figures of 31122 since switched to handicapping.

comments.bearisland: Finished ninth in both handicaps and she needs improvement back up in trip; hood removed
comments.bothofus: Has a good pedigree and he's a possible improver upped in trip on handicap debut
comments.celestialodyssey: Well held in three maidens and she needs to show a lot more on this handicap debut
comments.echoofglory: Win and close third since switched to handicaps and he still has potential; respected
comments.harryella: Has wide draw but he still has untapped potential and is not ruled out back in trip
comments.hottalent: Has been gelded and now goes handicapping but he needs a transformation after 209 days off
comments.ifollowrivers: Has record of 31122 since handicapping and that latest second was a close call; big player
comments.lepelerin: Better effort when third at Yarmouth and has possibilities if he can build on that
comments.moonlightbomb: Still unexposed but he needs improvement back on AW
comments.pacifist: Has struggled since her maiden win in January and needs a big turnaround
comments.papaoscar: Handicap newcomer but he has a tough draw and this is competitive after a break; new yard
comments.rorysgold: Still unexposed but he needs a much more dynamic effort on this drop back in trip
comments.venturadream: Won at Southwell in February but he's been generally disappointing since; down the list
comments.wisestars: Finished third in her three qualifying runs and needs a close look on handicap debut

races.raceComment: ifollowrivers is marginally preferred with a score of 45.5%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions and stronger recent form and superior course form over harryella. comments.americantreasure: Failed to build on earlier promise when seventh at Chelmsford; could still do better

comments.drumstick: Hooded and hinted at a revival when sixth at Nottingham latest; weighted to go well
comments.pacificprince: Has offered little all three runs; needs this switch to h'caps to spark major improvement
comments.racingcountry: Off 16 months before last of seven for new yard at Southwell latest; others appeal more
comments.reignman: Modest form shown in his three runs to date; may do better now going handicapping though
comments.romanovich: Won at Chepstow; backed it up with good fourth there 23 days ago; ought to be thereabouts
comments.staceyracey: Course winner but she comes here below par; she's hard to make a case for
comments.wadacregrace: C&D scorer; below-par fifth at Wolver 16 days ago; could bounce back though

races.raceComment: wadacregrace is marginally preferred with a score of 54.1%, holding clear edges in more proven at trip and better suited by conditions and more reliable profile over adace. Placed in 2 of last 6 starts. Ground (Standard To Slow) looks ideal with 4 wins from 26 starts in similar conditions. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter, potentially favoring the selection's run style. Key attributes include optimal distance, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: Black Smoke holds claims under a penalty but a chance is taken on COGITAL who ran a more encouraging race here last time.

comments.blacksmoke: Overcame a steadily run race over 2m at Chepstow a week ago; claims under a 4lb penalty
comments.cogital: Returned to some form when third of eight here over 2m last time; needs to back that up
comments.endofastorm: 3-28; ran to a similar level in two starts in May; back up in trip with better needed
comments.fabuleuxduclos: Dual winner over hurdles in 2023; struggled since returning from a lengthy absence
comments.innisfreepearl: Improved form when switched to handicaps last year; below that level so far this season
comments.mujid: 10yo who has been off since December; won this last year; cheekpieces removed for return
comments.sugarpiehoneybunch: Made a winning return over 1m4f at Hamilton last time; back up in trip following 5lb rise

races.raceComment: mujid is marginally preferred with a score of 43.6%, holding clear edges in better ratings and more progressive over blacksmoke. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter, though returning from absence and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.
